title: Juicy American Chicken Stew
description: A comforting and winey American dish featuring brandy, grilled chicken, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, served in a mason jar.

ingredients.name: brandy
ingredients.notes: or substitute with apple cider vinegar

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.notes: dry, such as merlot or cabernet

instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat and grill the chicken until browned on all sides.
In a large bowl, whisk together the brandy, red wine, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Add the grilled chicken, onion, carrots, and potatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the mixture to a large mason jar and bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the stew from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days and reheat before serving.
